motion.name: stage-glyph
motion.purpose: Only the running investigation stage moves; none under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Starts an investigation or saves settings.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0064e0; color: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; height: 42px; padding: 0 18px; font: 550 14px 'Onest Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0b74ff; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0064e0; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Rail Item
components.description: History and navigation entries on the navy rail.
components.html: SettingsThe Eiffel Tower is in Paris.
components.css: .ds-rail { background: #0a1322; padding: 12px; display: grid; gap: 2px; width: 220px; } .ds-rail-item { color: #a3b5ca; padding: 9px 10px; border-radius: 6px; font: 13px 'Onest Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-rail-item:hover { background: #14233a; color: #e8eef7; } .ds-rail-item.is-active { background: #f3e6d6; color: #0f2742; font-weight: 550; }

components.name: Quoted Evidence
components.description: Source excerpt with the passage the finding rests on highlighted.
components.html: … the photo has circulated since 2012; the original shows a single-headed cobra photographed in India …
components.css: .ds-quote { margin: 0; padding-left: 12px; border-left: 1px solid #2d4264; font: 14px/1.7 'Onest Variable', sans-serif; color: #e8eef7; } .ds-quote mark { background: #f3e6d6; color: #0b1626; padding: 1px 2px; border-radius: 2px; }

keyCharacteristics: Dark by default; no light mode.
One action blue; lighter blue for links on dark.
Cream is a highlighter and the mark, never a panel color.
Verdict colors only from the state palette.

rules.name: The Highlighter Rule
rules.body: Cream marks the passage a finding rests on. Do not use it for panels, page backgrounds or decoration.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue never means true. Verdict colors come only from the state palette.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No small uppercase labels above headings. A number that orders claims sits beside the heading, not above it.
